About

I'm a mechanical engineer who likes the part where hardware meets software: airframes, flight controllers, onboard vision, sensor integration and field testing. My latest drone qualified for Phase 2 of SAEINDIA AeroTHON 2026 with 17.56 minutes of measured flight endurance.

I work with Pixhawk/ArduPilot, Raspberry Pi 5, ESP32 and Arduino, model in SolidWorks and check designs in ANSYS. Right now I'm deepening Python, OpenCV and ML for robotics perception.
